notes.title: The Great Gate
notes.content:
Another small patch fixing some bugs reported by the community.

[list]
[*] There was an issue with some players being unable to progress past the gate to the final cutscene, that should be resolved now.
[*] We also took a community suggestion and changed the key to enter dev-mode to alt + D (previously was alt + ~) so it's more friendly to international keyboards.
[/list]

Happy Sneaking!

notes.title: Day 1 Update
notes.content:
Thanks everyone for trying Kore! Our team worked really hard to bring it to you and we're glad it's finally out for the public to enjoy.

Minor launch day update going out now which should fix an issue with the final progression achievement not triggering properly, add some clarity to dev mode, and make a few other extremely minor tweaks. 

Happy sneaking!
